title: dicoma sessiliflora subsp. kirkii
intro: Dicoma sessiliflora subsp. kirkii, commonly known as Kirk's dicoma or Kirk's bush, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Dicoma sessiliflora subsp. kirkii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
